speed_ratio_definition: median of three complete Cantera batch means / median of three complete Julia batch means
scope: Complete published transport sequences, including fresh flame construction, initialization, solver setup, continuation, adaptive solves and required numerical profiles. Loaded mechanisms are reused. Imports, compilation, mechanism/sidecar loading, validation and file I/O are excluded.

timing_policy.explicit_collection: One after excluded warmup on both runtimes; automatic GC remains enabled and included in all measured calls.
timing_policy.qualification: All physical, replay, source, timing and local-CI gates must pass. Noise failure is inconclusive; stable subthreshold speed is below target.

accuracy.reference: First-order CT extrapolation from controlled whole-grid bisection, with last-extrapolation change retained.

wsl.warmup_gc_policy: One explicit collection after the excluded first complete sequence on each runtime; automatic GC remains enabled and timed during measured calculations.
